name: Problem conversation
audience: People choosing a bounded way to investigate a specific business uncertainty
scope: Explore a recent concrete problem, its context and current workaround; prepare neutral questions, not a sales pitch.
unknowns: Suitable participants, permissions, materials and access until explicitly confirmed
Actual observations and outcomes until recorded with sources
boundaries: Cannot establish prevalence, willingness to pay or future behavior from a conversation alone.
This worksheet does not record execution, observations, validation or payments
Record actual results separately with provenance; retain later changes to the decision rule
User-supplied dates cannot prove a plan preceded execution

sections.prompt: Which specific problem and recent situation need clarification, before discussing a solution?

Prepare a neutral opening and questions: describe the last occurrence; what happened next; what workaround was used; what was difficult; what would contradict your assumption? Plan to ask permission before recording. Keep a blank notes structure for quotations, observations and your interpretations.
Which people actually experience this situation? State selection criteria and recruitment route; leave identities and availability unknown until confirmed.
Estimate preparation, conversation and analysis time separately. Which materials and consent arrangements are needed? Do not assume free access or confirmed participants.

Plan to record a concrete occurrence, workaround and consequences, including contrary examples. Link each actual quotation or observation to its source; distinguish reported behavior from observed behavior.
What specific answers would make you narrow, change or abandon the problem assumption? How will you avoid treating polite agreement as confirmation?
Set a time limit, permission boundary and stopping rule. Do not record unwanted personal details or turn questions into leading claims.
